title: Akil knows about the amputee athlete film his mother watched downstairs

tellings.quote: movie of athlete whose leg was amputed and he got into Special Olympics

plain: A woman named Manisha appeared on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, in an episode about a documentary on children said to read minds, and she tells a story about a boy named Akil at home in New Jersey. According to the story's framing, she had watched a film downstairs about an athlete whose leg was amputated and who went on to the Special Olympics, and Akil knew about it without having seen it. If true, it would suggest the boy picked up what was in her mind.
